ABBI FARM  ·  THE OPPORTUNITY WAXWIT
— The Honest Truth

Basic Marketing Attracts
Basic Clients.

Abbi Farm is not a basic venue. The pool deck, the grand interior, the sweeping lawns — this is a premium property built for premium celebrations. But if the Instagram page doesn't reflect that, the enquiries won't either. Weddings and parties are festivals in India. The feed should feel like one.

Basic Posts

  • Generic graphics & text cards
  • No brand visual identity
  • Random, inconsistent posting
  • Attracts bargain hunters
  • Low-value enquiries

Premium Creative Marketing

  • Cohesive, festive visual identity
  • Story-driven aspirational content
  • Quality over quantity, always
  • Attracts premium clients
  • High-value bookings

"Shaadis and parties are festivals in India. Your Instagram should feel like one."

ABBI FARM  ·  CONTENT STRATEGY WAXWIT
— Four Parallel Content Pillars

Not More Content.
Better Content.

All four pillars run simultaneously from Day One  ·  Quality of content is the only measure that matters

01

Mock Videos &
Short Story Reels

Cinematic short reels showing Abbi Farm transforming for different events — a baraat arriving, a corporate gala, a birthday by the pool. AI-generated and filmed scenarios that make viewers imagine their own celebration here.

  • Aspirational, story-driven content
  • AI-assisted scenario creation
  • Drives enquiry through emotion
02

Staff Videos
(Funny & Real)

The team that makes Abbi Farm run is the best marketing it has. Behind the scenes of event setup, the chef, the decorator at 2am. Real, warm, funny — the kind of content that gets shared in family WhatsApp groups.

  • Behind-the-scenes authenticity
  • Relatable, highly shareable
  • Builds human trust instantly
03

Founder Videos
(Most Important)

People book venues from people they trust. The founder talking about why Abbi Farm was built, what makes it different, the dream behind the glasshouse. Genuine, personal, unscripted — this is what converts browsers into bookings.

  • Personal founder story & vision
  • Glasshouse reveal series
  • Highest conversion content
04

Coming Soon
Campaign

Build anticipation before the doors open. One space revealed at a time. Atmospheric short reels with just music and visuals. Stories that ask the audience — what would you celebrate here? First enquiries before launch.

  • Space-by-space teaser reveals
  • Builds anticipation & enquiries
  • Bookings before official launch

All four pillars launch together  ·  Each serves a different purpose  ·  All work toward one goal: premium bookings

ABBI FARM  ·  LAUNCH ROADMAP WAXWIT
— Coming Soon Campaign

Build the Buzz
Before the Doors Open.

PHASE 1  ·  WEEKS 1–2

Set the Stage

Brand assets are delivered. Colour palette introduced. First post — a single hero image. No text. Just the beauty of the venue.

  • Logo & brand guidelines live
  • Colour palette introduced
  • Hero venue image drops
  • "Something beautiful is coming"
PHASE 2  ·  WEEKS 3–4

Reveal the Spaces

One space revealed per post — the pool, the interior, the lawns. 15-second atmospheric reels, music only. Stories with audience polls.

  • Pool deck & interior reveals
  • Lawn & porch reels drop
  • Stories: "What would you celebrate?"
  • Glasshouse teaser begins
PHASE 3  ·  WEEKS 5–6

Founder & Bookings

The founder introduces Abbi Farm. Personal, honest, genuine. The glasshouse vision is revealed. Enquiry link goes live. First bookings.

  • Founder introduction reel
  • Glasshouse full reveal
  • Enquiry link goes live
  • First premium bookings accepted
